text.insert: Changelog
2026-08-10 — v11: open questions pruned to the nine genuinely open items; the eight resolved round-1 questions and their decisions moved to the new decision log.

2026-08-10 — v10: worker-authored reports eliminated — the librarian condenses run transcripts + state directly; every attempt filed as observed, learnings cataloged as byproduct; intake is the single door into the brain of the harness.
2026-08-10 — v9: record renamed annotation → learning throughout (fields
learnings[]
learning_verdicts[]
, edge
HAS_LEARNING
, state-shape LearningRecord); connection-map canvas labels updated to match.
2026-08-10 — v8: bundle restructured around the system itself — per-target core (code graph + search indexes + attempt ledger), knowledge stores searched directly (knowledge ledger with
subject: symbol | file | area | general
, smashwiki corpus, standards), inputs slimmed to past PRs · discord · retired; design chapters folded into the sections they describe.

2026-08-10 — v7: stores catalog reorganized into the four target-anchored layers — code graph as epoch-rebuilt base walkability; search indexes (opseq · ghidra · siblings · crosswalk) grouped as per-target sweep axes; tactics nested under the attempt ledger as its view; knowledge ledger presented as human store + AI-inferred (one ledger, two origins).

2026-08-10 — v6: catalog restructured around build verbs — sources slimmed to true inputs (smashwiki, past PRs, discord); tree guide demoted to docs-only (seed import dropped — no evidence refs), path_facts and powerpc_docs folded into retired; ghidra reclassified as a computed store; stores grouped computed (target-tied) / events / beliefs / authored; annotations ledger renamed knowledge ledger with
origin: human_extracted | ai_inferred
; attempts gain
provenance: observed | inferred
; corroboration gate, graded tactic outcomes, and the interview decisions recorded in-doc. Connection map re-authored as an interactive canvas with shape semantics.
2026-07-02 — v5: restructured all prose into nested bullets — bold leads are now head bullets with sub-bullets (and sub-sub-bullets). Content unchanged; tables, diagram, and JSON blocks untouched.
2026-07-02 — v4: renamed "claim" → "annotation" throughout — "claim" collides with workers claiming targets from the queue (
claimId
in worker-cycle). The assertion text field is now
statement
. Concept unchanged: an evidence-backed belief about what a function/data means in game terms.
2026-07-02 — v3: removed powerpc_docs (unused — dropped from corpus cluster, surfaces, and migration verdict flipped to remove). JSON record blocks now syntax-highlighted.

2026-07-02 — v2: added the understanding layer as a fifth regime (annotations ledger): evidence-backed, content-hash anchored, graduating into upstream renames/comments. Reframed tactics as a view over attempts (removed direct tactic→target edge). Attempt record gains
annotations_produced
annotations_relied_on
. Tree guide becomes annotation seed material.
2026-07-02 — v1: initial draft from brainstorm session (maintenance regimes, connection map, attempt schema, migration map).
